title: Database dump with schema statements served
description: The response is a database dump: the dump tool banner and a CREATE TABLE statement are the header and body of an exported schema with rows. A web server that serves it hands over the schema and the data in the same response.
remediation: Remove the dump from the web root and move exports to a private store with access control. Treat the data as disclosed and assess notification duties for the rows it contained.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the dump banner and a CREATE TABLE statement; it cannot count the rows or tell which tables the export covers.
